injuryAndRoleContext: Buffalo's first Week 2 injury report was an estimation because the team did not practice Monday. Terrel Bernard (calf), Ty Johnson (hamstring) and T.J. Sanders (knee) were listed limited; Cole Bishop, Bradley Chubb and Daequan Hardy/Hancock-type secondary entries were reported full in public recaps. No fresh Tuesday official practice-status table materially changing a player-prop role was verified by this checkpoint.

Detroit's Monday estimated report listed Christian Mahogany (hip) and Blake Miller (knee) as DNP and Juice Scruggs (knee) limited. Beat reporting says Miller is optimistic and Dan Campbell was cautiously optimistic, while Mahogany appears less likely; no official Tuesday final status was verified at this checkpoint.

Isiah Pacheco's back surgery is not a new Week 2 usage delta because he was already on injured reserve and unavailable in Week 1. Brian Branch and Kerby Joseph remaining on PUP are likewise known defensive absences rather than a new signal.
